newsitem.title: INDIA: Technical snag delays trade on Delhi bourse.
newsitem.headline: Technical snag delays trade on Delhi bourse.

text.p: Trading on the Delhi Stock Exchange will begin at 11.00 a.m.(0530 GMT), 75 minutes late from the usual time of 9.45 a.m.,due to a technical snag, bourse officials said.
On Wednesday the bourse remained closed for the birth anniversary of Mahatma Gandhi, father of the nation.
The bourse's benchmark index had closed at 719.74 on Tuesday, 2.50 points below its previous close.
